    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, especially at market bottoms, causing delayed reversal entries",
    "Sentiment turning positive (0.33+) ahead of price rallies indicates model will undershoot true bottoms",
    "When price is consolidating near support, model mean-reversion targets are too aggressive",
    "Sentiment negativity (below 0.33) precedes model undershoot of price floors by 1-3 days",
    "Model tends to overshoot on the upside when sentiment remains positive during uptrends",
    "Correcting model bias by 10-20% using sentiment lag alignment reduces forecast error",
    "When price has strong momentum, model's mean-reversion component over-corrects opposite to true direction"
] }
